item.title: Detection Is Not Early Warning: Evaluating Token-Level Alarms on Language Model Failures
item.description: Many failures of language models begin at a specific token, the onset. A monitor that reads the model during generation can classify the finished response, detect the failure once it is under way, or warn before it begins, and only a warning leaves time to stop or steer the generation. Monitors are usually evaluated with response-level metrics such as AUROC, which ignore when the monitor fires. We introduce PREWARN, an evaluation protocol for any failure with an annotated onset. item.description: Gemini Decisions API Google join Jev and OpenAI in the decision model category with "Gemini Decision 1". This new model API is almost identical to Jev: it supports the same three types of questions (yes/no, choice, and rubric-scoring) and even reuses Jev's term "Noul" for a yes/no question. It's priced the same as the GPT-6 Luna decision model: 10 cents per million input tokens, and output is free. Jev remains the cheapest of the three, at 4.2 cents per million. item.title: Near-Optimal Regret for Oracle-Efficient Adversarial Contextual Bandits
item.description: We study contextual bandits with $K$ actions, a class of $N$ policies, and i.i.d.\ contexts from a distribution that the learner can sample. For any sequence of loss functions fixed before play, we give an oracle-efficient algorithm with expected regret $O(\sqrt{KT\log(2N)}\,\log(2KT))$ against the best policy in hindsight on the realized contexts. This improves the $T^{2/3}$ dependence on the horizon in prior oracle-efficient bounds and achieves the optimal regret rate in this setting up to logarithmic factors. Our algorithm perturbs policy scores using a Poisson sample of auxiliary contexts. — 来源：arxiv · aws_ml — 原文：https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17109v1

item.title: A Convex-Analytic Reformulation for Poisoning Attacks on Logistic Regression
item.description: We study data poisoning attacks on logistic regression with $\ell_2$-regularization, where an attacker chooses the features of a fixed number of injected observations with prescribed labels to maximize the logistic loss on the clean training data. Strong convexity of the defender's problem yields an exact reformulation through its first-order optimality conditions. Using convex conjugacy of the softplus function, we replace the sigmoid relations by a single convex optimality-gap inequality and express the attacker's objective as a concave function. item.title: VOKE: Visual Object Kinematics Estimator for Dexterous In-Hand Manipulation
item.description: Vision-based dexterous in-hand manipulation requires knowing not only where an object is, but also how it moves. However, most robotic manipulation systems rely on off-the-shelf visual perception models whose outputs are limited to static object masks, geometry, or 6D poses, leaving downstream controllers to infer object dynamics implicitly from noisy visual observations.
